hypotheses.name: Stability-selected sparse-descriptor consensus
hypotheses.method: Across immune/lung/external_lung with seeds 42/43/44, source/target-disjoint splits, and layers {0,3,7,11}, fit H70+sparse descriptor blends with bootstrap stability selection, then tested random-feature-subset, descriptor-shuffle, endpoint-swap, and label-permutation controls.
hypotheses.result_value: mean=+0.07424; positive rows=72/72; positive mean domain-splits=6/6; positive mean null-gap domain-splits=6/6; mean descriptor Jaccard=0.65046
hypotheses.next_action: Run one confirmatory pass with higher null resolution and freeze a compact stable descriptor core for mechanistic interpretation.

hypotheses.name: Scale-space lifetime trajectory descriptors
hypotheses.method: Seed42 breadth screen across immune/lung/external_lung, source/target-disjoint splits, and layers {0,3,7,11}; computed edge lifetime trajectories over kNN scales {8,10,12,14,16}, added trajectory-shape features to H70 baseline, and tested scale-order permutation, trajectory-feature shuffle, and label permutation controls.
hypotheses.result_value: mean=+0.00386; positive mean domain-splits=5/6; positive mean null-gap domain-splits=0/6
hypotheses.next_action: Retire this exact additive trajectory formulation and reuse scale-space descriptors only as diagnostics on stronger backbones.

hypotheses.name: Confidence/sign-weighted filtration rescue
hypotheses.method: Seed42 breadth run across immune/lung/external_lung, source/target-disjoint splits, and layers {7,11}; reweighted geodesic filtration by biological confidence and directed-support sign, blended weighted descriptors with H70 baseline, and tested confidence-shuffle, sign-flip, and label-permutation controls.
hypotheses.result_value: mean=+0.08443; positive rows=12/12; positive mean domain-splits=6/6; positive mean null-gap domain-splits=6/6
hypotheses.next_action: Replicate on seeds 43/44 with higher null draws and test adaptive weighted-threshold calibration.
